headline: Presolana long run done, volume on target, climbs ran 3bpm hot and 60% long
summary: 16.9km, 847m D+, 2h15 moving, avg 151bpm. D+ and duration hit the 130 prescription. The two tempo climbs ran 19min at 168bpm (Visolo) and 22min at 168bpm (Presolana > Cassinelli) against 12min at 160-166: roughly 40min above LTHR instead of 24min at it. The flat middle (km 7-9) sat at 160-162bpm, outside the 155 cap, so the grey-zone drift pattern showed up again. Descent cadence 166-170spm, at the floor of the 170+ target. Add the 4h Cassinelli hike (1h55 moving, 319m D+). Real load is likely 160-180 icu vs 130 planned; the week lands deeper than TSB -9.5.
flags: Climbs over-cooked: cap them at the prescribed minutes next time, the extra 7-10min above 166 buys fatigue, not fitness at this stage.
Flat running between climbs drifted to 160+: that is the recurring grey-zone habit, hold 145-155 between efforts.
Descent cadence 166-170spm: push 172-175 on the next mountain day.
suggestedChange: No change to Sunday load (55). Run it strictly 135-145bpm, flat, no pick-ups; swap to 75min spin at 120-135bpm if quads are sore or HRV is below 60. Wk3 stands as planned.
